Publication mapping does not retarget old approvals or renew numerical assessments. Artifact filenames in historical notes identify private source artifacts that are not included in this example.
reviewLimits: The latest bounded exploration refined two existing concepts and five realization readings, then added one qualitative process, three Event openings and twelve relations. It retained the already reviewed 13,342-word prose; this is not a prose-improvement claim.

The fixed latest read-back compared selected passages plus preceding context with that same context alone, using one isolated language-model reader per condition. Four targets were recovered with the selected passages; the control conveyed two and partly supported two. This is a local meaning-recovery comparison, not statistical or aesthetic validation.
The fresh 15-record depth assessment and zero affected declared dependencies cover a selected inquiry, not every implicit semantic dependency or every modeled life.

Fifty of the 120 Cuts retain recorded text bases; 70 have untracked text freshness. The latest qualitative exploration did not re-estimate their values or renew all numerical assessments. Recorded bases support text-change checks, not calibration or psychological truth.
The six-Cut review below is the historical September 28 assessment of the succession episode in the then-current 108-Cut revision. It is not a new approval of the present model.
Current telling-phase status checks stored quotations and order against the retained prose; it does not establish reader psychology or semantic truth.
Structural import, rendering and history checks do not establish historical truth, literary quality or the comparative benefits proposed in the paper.
